    Where it stands today

    What EEZ is built to do, and what runs now.
    AreaBy designToday
    All or nothingA call lands or reverts whole within one Ethereum block. A failed call on the other chain makes your call revert too. Your contract can catch it and carry on, or let it undo everything.As designed
    AccessAnyone can register a chain. Your own contracts decide who uses yours.As designed
    PrivacyPublic by design: counterparties and amounts are visible on Ethereum.As designed
    VerificationEach chain picks its own provers and how many must agree, with validity proofs as the target.One ECDSA signature checks each batch. Unaudited.
    Owner controlYour chain’s owner key sits under your own governance.The owner can replace the state root and change verifiers, with no delay.
    UpgradesUpgrades go through a multisig and a delay. Being confirmed.One key can upgrade the core contracts, with no delay.
    ValueETH and tokens move with the call, in the same transaction.Test bridge only. Production waits for a production proof system and an audit.
    InclusionThe composer prepares calls. A way to force a call in is not specified yet.The composer decides which calls land.

    Whether or not it’s right for you depends on three things.

    Which mainnet contracts you need. Whether you must move value or only read state. Where the permissioning authority sits.
